climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A PDO in the Duna region, the flat, sandy area between the Danube and Tisza rivers. Its rules allow still and sparkling wine from grapes including Kadarka, Kékfrankos, Merlot, Olasz Rizling and Kövidinka.
